metadata.domain: MCP servers, clients, tools, protocol schemas, package registry, QA agent integrations, search and install behavior, transports, schema drift, normalization, and contract testing
metadata.scoringScale: Each score is 0 to 10. Total is the sum of relevance, specificity, intentFit, and coverageAbility.
metadata.collisionPolicy: Reject exact or containing slugs, title or H1 token overlap above 60 percent after stopword removal, duplicate primary keyword intent, broad-guide overlap, and self-cannibalization.
metadata.sourcePolicy: Only official protocol, SDK, runtime, standards, registry, npm, GitHub, OWASP, and MITRE documentation is used.
